verdict.rationale: Jules provides a documented public API to create/manage sessions, send messages, and configure automation (automationMode, requirePlanApproval), explicitly for building custom workflows and CI-like automation, corroborated by a community member building an MCP server that dispatches tasks via the API. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline (e.g. GitHub Actions) example, no independent report of large-scale unattended CI usage.
